title: Workspaces
mobileDescription: Search projects and select a session to view its history.
deleteDescription: This workspace will be removed from the list. Open conversations will close and unsent drafts will be cleared. Local files and saved conversations will be kept; add the same folder again to restore the history.
deleteBusy: A conversation in this workspace is running or saving. Stop generation, remove queued messages, or wait for it to finish and try again.
deleteFailed: Could not confirm the workspace was deleted. Check your connection and try again.
folderHint: Choose a folder on this computer or enter its path.
browserFolderHint: Enter the full path to a folder on the computer running AlphaCode.
projectDescription: Name your project and select an existing folder as its working directory.
emptyProjects: Start a conversation or add a project folder.
invalidDirectory: Cannot access this folder. Check the full path and make sure it is an existing directory.
createFailed: Could not create the project. Check your connection and try again.
pickFailed: Could not open the folder picker. Try again or enter the path.
modelRequired: Configure a model in the AlphaCode global settings before creating a project.
